description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Saffi dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lurrus, adding {G}.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.
